lines.en: Grandma, look at this big whale picture.
lines.ko: 할머니, 이 큰 고래 그림 좀 봐요.

lines.en: Oh, it's huge. Do you like the dolphin too?
Yes. The dolphin is nicer than the shark.
We saw a turtle at the beach last summer.
I remember. Did we see a jellyfish there?
Yes, one jellyfish moved near the coral then.
lines.ko: 네, 그때 해파리 한 마리가 산호 가까이 움직였어요.

lines.en: Can an octopus and a crab live together?
lines.ko: 문어하고 게가 함께 살 수 있어요?

lines.en: Yes, they live in the sea with shrimp.
I want to dive and see them someday.
Thank you for reading. We will visit the sea.
lines.ko: 읽어 줘서 고마워요. 우리 바다에 가 볼게요.

lines.en: Hello. We have fresh crab and shrimp today.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 오늘은 신선한 게하고 새우가 있어요.

lines.en: Hello. Is that octopus fresh today?
Yes, it came this morning from the sea.
Good. My family likes crab soup very much.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 우리 가족은 게 국을 아주 좋아해요.

lines.en: Then take this crab. It is big and clean.
lines.ko: 그럼 이 게를 가져가세요. 크고 깨끗해요.

lines.en: Thank you. Do you sell shrimp and small fish?
Yes, we do. We sell them every morning.
lines.ko: 네, 팔아요. 매일 아침에 팔고 있어요.

lines.en: My grandson asked about a shark yesterday.
Oh, does he like the dolphin show too?
Yes, he does. We will go there on Sunday.
lines.ko: 네, 좋아해요. 우리는 일요일에 거기 갈 거예요.
